summary: Implemented `in` membership for namespaces in rdflib/namespace.py: Namespace.__contains__ returns ref.startswith(self) (prefix test, reference as receiver); ClosedNamespace.__contains__ returns True only if ref equals a stored term URI under node-type-aware equality, inherited by _RDFNamespace. Also changed ClosedNamespace._ipython_key_completions_ to return dir(self.uri) per the spec. Added tests to test/test_namespace.py covering prefix positive/negative/self, SH, RDFS positive/undefined/non-URIRef, RDF positive, and container property (_1 is False). Nothing was run: per instructions I only read and edited files, so the tests are unverified. Changes are uncommitted. The _ipython_key_completions_ change is literal to the spec; dir() of a string lists str methods, so confirm that is intended. NamespaceManager membership was not added (optional, and it would have needed a behavior change).
